hero.h1: AI is the right hand of human talent.
hero.p: We design the workflows where your team and artificial intelligence each do what they do best. No replacements. No shortcuts. With judgment.

tesis.h2: AI doesn't replace humans. It amplifies them. Humans don't slow AI down. They direct it. Slowcraft designs that collaboration.
tesis.b1: Artificial intelligence is the most powerful copilot in history. But a copilot without a pilot who knows the destination doesn't get far.
tesis.b2: The mistake isn't adopting AI late. It's adopting it without design. The companies that will win this decade are the ones that designed best how they work with it.
tesis.b3: Your team and AI are your two most valuable resources. Our job is to design how they shake hands so both do what they do best.

metodo.h2: Three phases. One architecture. Measurable results.

f1.p: We map how your company works today. We identify where AI can be a powerful copilot for your team — and where it's better not to touch anything yet.

f2.p: We design human–AI workflows with purpose. We define what the machine does best, what people do best, and how they complement each other at every step.

f3.p: We integrate the right tools, train the team, and measure real results. We stay until the system works in sync.

serv.intro: For companies that want to rethink how they work with AI. Transformational projects, with scope open to diagnosis. Three types.

items.p: Strategic diagnosis for companies that want to enter the AI era well. Without wasting capital or time.

programs.intro: For companies that want sustained improvement in how they work with AI. Monthly commitment, scalable.

items.p: Monthly access to our team to resolve strategic questions, review implementations, and unblock initiatives.
A Slowcraft consultant working embedded with your team. For companies in active transformation.
AI adoption is not a race. Quick decisions today are the expensive problems of tomorrow.
AI is the tool. Your team decides what to do with it. None of our designs starts without understanding the team.
We design portable architectures. We don't marry you to a vendor or a platform.
Every engagement has concrete success metrics. If it can't be measured, we don't recommend it.

sobre.h2: A boutique AI strategy consultancy in Mexico City.
sobre.p1: Slowcraft is born from the observation that most companies are adopting AI in a rush. They buy tools without designing the flow. They replace people without understanding the cost. They chase the hype without strategy.
sobre.p2: We work with a handful of companies at a time. We focus on clients who want to do things right. Who understand that AI is a strategic decision, not an IT experiment.
